name: refine-prompt
description: Interviews the user to find what they are actually trying to achieve, then rewrites their prompt into a sharper, more ambitious, frontier-calibrated version.

interface.shortDescription: Interview and rewrite rough prompts into sharper, more ambitious, frontier-calibrated briefs.
interface.longDescription: Turns a rough prompt into a sharper, more ambitious, frontier-calibrated brief by diagnosing context first, calibrating against live frontier capabilities, running a concise hypothesis-led multiple-choice interview, and rewriting with clear outcomes, raw inputs, ambitious bars, and external verification.
capabilities: Altitude, Depth, Range, and Frontier prompt rewriting
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $refine-prompt to interview me and rewrite this prompt into a sharper, more ambitious, frontier-calibrated version.
